work.author: Clemens Papa XIII.
work.description: Entire CCCLXIV letter to Elisabeth and context read. Literal issuer LF79365, own address and salutation, substantive opening LF79372 and coherent body to own dating LF79434–79439 are complete. Historical annotation LF79352–79357 refers to earlier letters and does not replace this body. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
